{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool-blend turtleneck, slim fit, hip length, soft ivory (#EFE8DC), fine merino blend

Straight-leg trousers, high waist, full ankle length, charcoal grey (#3E4249), heavy wool crepe

Tailored overcoat, single-breasted, knee length, camel (#B58B5E), brushed wool with cashmere

Ankle boots, low block heel, round toe, black (#1C1C1E), smooth leather with a warm lining

Wool scarf, wide and generously long, dusty blue (#7FA6C8), soft felted wool

Knit gloves, wrist length, charcoal grey (#4A4D52), cashmere blend

Structured tote bag, medium size, deep brown (#4A3426), grained leather

Why this outfit works: The neat business look of a refined knit with tailored trousers and ankle boots suits the office, and the heavy wool and the overcoat keep her warm on a frosty autumn walk. The soft ivory near her face brightens her fair skin, and the dusty blue scarf echoes her eyes while sitting well with her silver-grey hair. The high-waisted straight trousers and the knee-length coat create a long, clean line, and the low block heel is steady and comfortable for walking. The camel, charcoal and ivory palette is calm and professional, so every piece mixes easily with the rest of her wardrobe."}
